data.one_liner: Flutter widget to show MJPEG stream from URL, stopping automatically when off screen
data.what_it_does: Provides a full Dart implementation of an MJPEG reader widget for Flutter. It connects to an HTTP stream URL to render camera video frames, handling errors, loading states, custom headers, and stopping the connection when the widget is not on screen.
use_when: You need to stream video from an IP camera using the MJPEG format.
You want a widget that automatically stops streaming and closes the HTTP client when not visible on screen.
avoid_when: You are playing standard video formats like MP4 or H.264 streams.
You require advanced media player features like seeking, audio tracks, or non-HTTP streaming protocols.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no native code required.
Automatically manages network resources by stopping when not on screen.
Supports custom HTTP clients, headers, and frame preprocessors.
weaknesses: Lacks advanced video controls and features found in dedicated media player libraries.
data.setup_notes: No native setup required as it is a pure Dart implementation.
